rows.grounds: pronoun idam in instrumental/genitive feminine singular referring to the mudrā just described
viracana in instrumental singular plus eva; the plus marks the joined elements within the token
feminine plural nominative adjective agreeing with devatāḥ
third-person plural present active of root sidh
feminine plural nominative noun, subject of siddhyanti

items.question: By what means alone are all deities accomplished through this mudrā?
premises: The mudrā's performance is the stated means.
All deities are said to be accomplished.
The accomplishment is tied to that performance alone.
items.inference: Performing this mudrā alone accomplishes all deities.
uncertainties: Whether asyā is instrumental or genitive in this context.
Whether siddhyanti is best read as passive accomplishment or active attainment.
items.plain_english: By its performance alone, all deities are accomplished.
